meridian.hint: Read the roster in the gallery. Count the names.

gallery.text: At the edge of the glass floor, a lectern with a clipboard chained to it. The roster of the resonator tuning group: eleven names in the same hand, Dr. Varga-Okoro at the top. You count them. Twelve.

text_by_lens.machine: A shift roster for the resonator tuning group, observation gallery, day of the test. Eleven staff. The count keeps coming out as twelve, which is an error somewhere.
text_by_lens.ritual: A roll of eleven names, kept like a litany. There is room at the bottom for one more, and the space has been worn smooth by a thumb.
text_by_lens.resonance: Eleven names spaced like the nodes of a wave. The gap after the last one is exactly one name wide.
text_by_lens.prison: A sign-in sheet for a door that should stay shut. Eleven went in. The twelfth line is for whoever lets them out.
text_by_lens.mirror: The roster lists eleven names. The twelfth is whoever is reading it, and it is in your handwriting.

choices.label: Count them again, slowly, with your finger on each line.
Read the names aloud, the way a roll is called.
Read the roster through the Inward Scope.
Lay the Dirty Glove flat on the page and feel for a pulse.

counted.text: Eleven. You were sure. Then a twelfth line under Varga-Okoro's, blank, initialled in your initials. Beside it someone has drawn a tuning fork with no tines.

called.text: Eleven names, and on each one the static in the gallery answers "here". On the twelfth it says nothing, and then it says your name, and "here" in your voice.

notes_on_you.text: Through the backward eyepiece the roster is not a roster. It is a page of field notes, and the subject is you: the way you walk, what you carry, which fork you will choose. The last line is underlined twice.

pulse_on_page.text: The paper has a pulse, slower than yours. It quickens under the twelfth line. The glove comes away with a new stain the shape of a name.

lectern_shelf.text: On the shelf under the lectern: a microscope built the wrong way round, and a single left-hand surgical glove, never sterile. A note in Varga-Okoro's hand: whoever finishes the measurement will need both.

twelfth_line.text: You count twelve. You count eleven. You count twelve, and the twelfth is standing behind you. You do not turn around. You leave.

answered.text: Every name answers, including one you did not read. You stop. The gallery is full, and then it is empty.

eyepiece_blink.text: Something on the other side of the eyepiece blinks first. You lose a minute, and your place in the notes.

glove_chooses.text: The glove chooses where to press, and it chooses the twelfth line. The page goes cold under it.

scrap_recounts.text: There is a box of scrap under the lectern. You count it and get a different number each time, each smaller than the last.
